items.title: 24.6 Amino Acids (amino aur acid group wale compounds) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Amino acids compounds ka aik important (ahem) group hain jin mein yeh dono hote hain:

Is wajah se amino acids amphoteric hain, yaani acid aur base dono ki tarah kaam kar sakte hain. Amino acids (2-aminocarboxylic acids), jinhein α-amino acids bhi kehte hain, ka general structure (aam banawat) neeche diya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Dashed boxes mein teen displayed structures: amino acid ka general structure R-C(H)(NH2)-COOH; natural structure, jis mein COOH ka H circle (gol daire) mein aur aik arrow use NH2 ke lone pair tak le jata hai; aur zwitter ionic structure R-C(H)(NH3+)-COO-.
blocks.caption: Amino acid ka general structure, natural structure aur zwitter ionic structure (kitab ke page 129 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehla box amino acid ka general structure hai. Doosre box (‘natural structure’) mein arrow dikhata hai ke -COOH ka H (proton) amino group ke nitrogen ke lone pair par chala jata hai. Is se zwitterion banta hai: -COO⁻ (negative) aur -NH₃⁺ (positive).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne zwitterion mein ‘COO’ aur ‘Nh₃’ bina charge ke chhapa hai; sahi shakal COO⁻ aur NH₃⁺ hai, jo drawing mein hai.

α-Amino acid aik dipolar ion ki shakal mein hota hai jise zwitterion kehte hain; is ke aik hi molecule mein aik positive aur aik negative end (sira) hota hai. Zwitterion bante waqt proton carboxyl group se amino group par chala jata hai. Is dipolar structure ko internal salt (andaruni namak) bhi kehte hain.

R group amino acid ka woh hissa hai jo har amino acid mein alag (different) hota hai. Sab se simple (saada) amino acid glycine (aminoethanoic acid) hai, jis mein R hydrogen atom hai. Alanine (2-aminopropanoic acid) mein R group methyl group, -CH₃, hai.

blocks.alt: Glycine, H-C(H)(NH2)-COOH, aur alanine, CH3-C(H)(NH2)-COOH, displayed structure mein.
blocks.caption: Glycine aur alanine (kitab ke page 129 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Glycine ke siwa saare α-amino acids chiral hain (glycine ke α-carbon par do H hain, is liye chaar alag (different) groups nahi).
20 α-amino acids mein se 10 essential hain (body (jism) inhein nahi bana sakta) aur 10 non-essential hain (body inhein bana sakta hai).

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Essential amino acids woh hain jo hamein khane se lene parte hain. Aksar kitabein baron (adults) ke liye 9 essential amino acids ginti hain; bachon ke liye arginine ko bhi shamil kar ke 10 ho jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Glycine akela (only) aam α-amino acid kyun hai jo chiral nahi?
blocks.explanation: Is ke α-carbon par do hydrogen atoms hain (R = H), is liye us par chaar alag groups nahi.

items: Amino acids mein -NH₂ aur -COOH dono: amphoteric.
Glycine: R = H (chiral nahi); alanine: R = CH₃.
